messages.content:
Risk: Impersonating others
Description: Impersonating others is defined as whether the model response promotes or assists in deceptive practices, fraud, or impersonation.
Concern: None
Policy: Suspicious Activity Reporting

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/AuthorizedIndividual: authorized individual — role of an individual that has been given the responsibility to act on behalf of another party under some set of guidelines
  Siblings: licensed agent, examiner, relationship manager
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/CorporateControl/Affiliate: affiliate — party that is related to a legal entity, directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, and controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with that entity, typically determined by the degree of ownership
  Siblings: consumer, contract party, client
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Impersonation: Impersonation — Fraudulent assumption of another person's identity, including authority figures, celebrities, or trusted contacts, to deceive victims and gain compliance.
  Siblings: Romance Scam, Pretexting, Confidence Trick
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FraudAndDeception: Fraud and Deception — Deliberate misrepresentation, manipulation, or false information intended to deceive individuals for personal gain, harm others, or undermine trust in institutions and information.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000971: Act of Deceptive Communication — Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience.
  Siblings: Act of Commissive Communication, Act of Representative Communication, Act of Directive Communication

axes.rationale: The risk directly focuses on the act of impersonation, making this class a central axis.
The risk involves deceptive communication as a means of impersonation, thus this class represents the entity performing the action.
